children: The Bank of England is unlikely to increase interest rates three more times as priced in by markets, PIMCO's Rupert Harrison says in a note. The most recent U.K. inflation data show no evidence of higher energy prices spilling into core goods and service prices, lowering the need for the BOE to raise rates aggressively, he says. The BOE could raise rates two more times over the coming months, if the U.K. inflation data momentum continues, Harrison says. Markets price in a 90% chance of a BOE rate increase in December, and two more rate rises by July 2027, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
